structured_output.world_model: W6: time ≈ 0.1 s + steps × per-step cost; accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps (~1.5 s/pp). Late freezes of finished layers are cheap; early or intermittent stem cuts cost accuracy. The tip's population mean is ~0.752–0.754 and build-to-build noise is ~±0.2 pp on 3 seeds. Diagnostics (I088, I094) change no recipe, so their time lands at the tip's ~5.2 s ±0.1 s. Candidates E046, E052 and E053 re-measure at their earlier times (5.08, 4.99, 5.07 s), but their accuracy re-rolls from the build. A coarse-label idea (I091) is probably blocked by the rules or by the data loader. I092 is probably closed by the code: the BN weight already has requires_grad=False.

forecasts.reason: Diagnostic with no recipe change; the three builds will likely differ by ~0.1 pp in 20-seed mean and fresh seeds will read slightly below 0.7539.
The gate with σ_tot of ~0.15 pp needs a mean of ≥0.752, which E052 and E053 probably miss, so likely nothing is re-kept or only marginally.
E046 sits ~0.1 s below E049 for roughly 0.05–0.1 pp, implying a dial of about 1–2 s/pp with wide error.
Likely blocked because the hard-coded mapping counts as external data; if it runs, the effect is small.
The code sets BN weight requires_grad=False, so this closes by reading with no run, and numbers equal the tip.
The whitening-bias saving is below the time noise and the accuracy effect is small and noisy.
Update-rate curves will likely order the known outcomes loosely, with group 1 decaying late and the whitening bias early.

cruxes: What is the rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean (H4.5.1)? It decides whether any sub-0.15 pp keep decision is meaningful.
Does the keep gate allow a population mean of ~0.7515 (E052/E053)? If so, 5.0 s becomes the tip.
Are coarse labels available in the shipped training data under the rules (I091)?
